body: @jellehenkens Baby steps :) I first got the status code fixed so far, but I agree, it would be nice if we could further get closer to the actual output. Maybe by not stubbing send(), but a submethod _send() which then does the actual sending then. So the other methods before this one will still be executed fine.

Hehe, I kinda went off the grid in the open source community for a while. Let's catch up on irc some day :)

@dereuromark I was thinking something similar, refactor build into 2 methods, one that prepared magic stuff and a sub method that sends it. Then we can mock the sub method for testing.
We could just mock the `_sendContent` and `_sendHeader` methods
We still have to mock send() though, we don't really want `fastcgi_finish_request` to happen within a unit test.
@jellehenkens The function will not be called in CLI
I can take a look at this.

repository.name: cakephp

issue.body:
This fix uses Hash::merge instead of += to merge the properties of the mocked Request. This allows a developer to add environment variables for the mocked request. Allowing to test Basic Auth logic.

Related ticket: https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/issues/6340#issuecomment-93645680
